prompt:
## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Treatment Product
where: TreatmentService (uses), src/business/treatmentService.ts, component business
code:
=====SOURCE-BEGIN
return this.products.create({ name: requireText(name, "name"), withdrawalDays });
=====SOURCE-END=====

### B

=====SOURCE-END=====

response.rationale: These are two different concepts. A is a treatment product, a catalogue item with a name and withdrawal days, created through ProductRepository: "return this.products.create({ name: requireText(name, \"name\"), withdrawalDays });". B is a treatment, the record of a product being applied to a hive, stored as TreatmentRecord items in TreatmentRepository: "private readonly items: TreatmentRecord[] = [];". The graph backs this up: TreatmentService calls ProductRepository and TreatmentRepository separately, and also calls TreatmentRepository.findByHive. So a product and a treatment that uses a product are related, but they are not the same thing.
